text:
maria: Quick thread — spotted that v2 now wraps validation errors in { error: { type, message, param } } vs v1's flat message. The migration guide still shows the old shape. We should update the "handling errors" section and the SDK snippets. cc @kevin @samantha
kevin: Oof, thanks. I ran into this when migrating embed calls. Which doc/file is this in?
maria: docs/migration/errors.md (around the examples). Also the JS snippet in SDK examples reads `err.message` only. We should show robust handling like `err.error?.message || err.message` and include the `type` field.
samantha: I'm the owner of that doc — I'll take it. Can we standardize on showing both the native v2 shape and a tiny compatibility shim so users are safe during rollout?
tim: @samantha please also add a short note about retry semantics — v2 surfaces `retry-after` in seconds for 429s, and we recommend the jittered exponential backoff in our SDKs. Add the snippet and call out the difference from v1.
kevin: I'll open a tiny PR to update the SDK snippet in examples. Plan: update error helper in examples repo and add a one-line test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 (draft)
maria: Awesome. @docs-bot can you add a deprecation banner to the old v1 examples page and create a checklist card? Target: ship docs updates by EOD Thu.
docs-bot: Added task to docs-board #612 and tagged engineering-docs reviewers. Reminder set for Thu 18:00 UTC.
samantha: PR is ready for review and includes a suggested code example to paste into SDK snippets: 

```
try {
  await client.generate(...)
} catch (err) {
  // support both v2 error envelope and older flat errors
  const body = err?.response?.data || err
  const msg = body?.error?.message || body?.message || String(err)
  const code = body?.error?.type || body?.code || 'unknown'
  console.error('Generation failed', { code, msg })
}
```

kevin: LGTM — I'll mirror that helper in the JS/TS SDK examples and add a short unit test for the error unmarshal.
maria: Great. Also add a bullet in the migration checklist: "errors + retry-after header behavior + model-fallback alias naming" — I'll update the checklist doc after PR merges.
tim: Thanks everyone, this should cut down on noisy support tickets once we publish. :rocket:
kevin: One more nit — we should include a one-line note about how the hosted API will keep a thin v1 shim for 30 days after docs change, so customers see both shapes temporarily. I'll add that to the PR description.
maria: Perfect. Closing loop — reviewers: @kevin @tim please review before EOD Wed so we can ship Thu.
samantha: Got it, will ping when CI green. :pray:
